# omni_user (Data Source)

Looks up an Omni user by ID or email address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The user's unique ID. One of `id` or `user_name` is required.
- `user_name` (String) The user's email address. One of `id` or `user_name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
- `display_name` (String) The user's display name.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the groups the user belongs to.
